verdict.rationale: Buzz can be self-hosted on your own relay. The Helm chart runs against operator-controlled Postgres, Redis and S3, and the vision states 'that place is yours.' That gives indirect control over where data is stored and whether it is kept, but the evidence documents no explicit retention policy, message or channel deletion, or data-purge feature. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, user- or admin-facing message/history deletion, documented data-purge or export-and-delete workflows, and independent corroboration.
